1_public_contracts.summary: Typed scene, component, event, semantics, version and ownership contracts are consumed through the root native facade; rejection and capability boundaries are explicit.

2_formal_engine_blitz.summary: Application code uses the formal Engine/HostRenderer path. Whole-frame add, remove, reorder, style, text and semantic updates commit atomically; CPU native frames feed checked backend submission and presentation.

3_render_host_lifecycle.summary: CPU Surface, injected fonts and DPI are connected; GPU TextureView presentation and present acknowledgement are implemented. HostRenderer gates each operation by active Surface generation and covers suspend, resume and retirement.

4_interaction_external_service.summary: Focus, pointer, capture, cancellation, rebinding, deletion and retirement are routed through public contracts. TextInputSession consumes authoritative external display snapshots and transient native preedit without owning a second editor; AccessKit conversion and platform bridge limits are explicit.

5_public_callers.summary: hello, pointer, window, gpu_window and full_scene use only formal public entries. The full declaration-to-retirement caller, pure visual focus/scroll/accessibility preservation, X11 click, lifecycle generation gate and a same-VM CPU baseline pass.

6_closeout.summary: All prior item branches are integrated. Source hashes, tool pins, formatting, dependency pin, default/native CPU/native GPU builds, default tests, 179 native CPU library tests, native integration, AccessKit, X11/host lifecycle and software Vulkan tests pass in the resource-limited VM.
